pages/Details.vue: 到访之前，先认识一下小屋
A LITTLE KNOW-HOW BEFORE YOU VISIT
A little guide to the studio
怎么来、在哪里停车，以及来拼豆时我们为你准备的小事。
Getting here, finding parking, and the little things we have ready for you.
位于汉密尔顿市中心，公交与城际公共交通可达。
In downtown Hamilton, accessible by local buses and GO Transit.
预约到访，可比约定时间稍早一点到。
Visits are by appointment. You are welcome to arrive a little before your confirmed time.
窗边明亮的拼豆工作台
Light-filled worktables by the studio window
楼下有免费的访客停车位，一般工作日有空位，实际以到访时情况为准。
Free visitor parking is available downstairs, usually with space on weekdays. Availability can vary when you arrive.
带上喜欢的图，其他慢慢来
舒适的老板椅、独立座位，一组客人一套拼豆，无需拼桌或共用豆子。桌上配齐工具，操作台的备用工具也可自行取用；缺豆时告诉店主即可。
A comfortable chair, an individual seat and a set of beads for your group. Tools are ready on the table, with spares at the workbench. Ask the host whenever you need more beads.
店主持续研究不同烫法。中小图熨烫、小图特殊烫免费；超过 78 格的大图需额外收费。想要的风格，可以先一起聊聊。

We keep exploring different ironing techniques. Small and medium pieces, including special finishes for small pieces, are ironed free. Larger pieces over 78 grid spaces carry an extra charge, discussed beforehand.
Little things to take with you
常规冰箱贴、手机链和挂件制作免费，风铃等复杂款式另计费用。店里也有相框、毛毡板等可现场选购。额外收费都会事先说明，征得你的同意后再做。

Standard magnets, phone straps and charms are finished free. Complex pieces such as wind chimes cost extra. Frames and felt boards are also available in the studio. We explain any extra charge and ask you before proceeding.
店里备有零食、水果和饮用水。当天没拼完的图案，可以在店内存放，最长保留 5 天。
Snacks, fruit and drinking water are available. If you do not finish your pattern that day, we can keep it in the studio for up to five days.
个别豆子可能有混色、毛刺或静电等出厂情况，通常不影响熨烫。手作熨烫可能留下少量纤维或纹理痕迹；很在意细节的话，可以自行烫豆，店里提供工具。

Occasional mixed colours, burrs or static are normal material variations and usually do not affect ironing. Handmade finishes may have small fibres or texture marks. If you prefer to iron your own piece, tools are available.
请采用正常逐颗拼豆的方式，不使用撒豆等非常规操作。撒落或混合的豆子需自行整理，或另付清洁费用；如需收费，会先和你确认。
Please place beads individually rather than scattering them. Spilled or mixed beads need to be sorted, or a cleaning fee may apply. Any fee is discussed with you first.
计时以实际拼豆时长为准，超出 15 分钟按半小时计。介绍新朋友消费、分享体验（例如小红书）有九折或小礼物等安排，具体适用方式请与店主确认。

Hourly visits are measured by actual making time; more than 15 minutes counts as half an hour. Referring a new friend or sharing your experience can qualify for a 10% discount or a small gift. Ask the host which offer applies.

An afternoon, a few little things, and a warm moment to yourself.
欢迎光临小狗拼豆铺。也许是某个下午吧，选自己喜欢的图，坐进阳光里，把一颗颗豆子，变成独属于你的快乐。

小狗拼豆铺的白色工作台、拼豆作品墙与自然光
Sunlit worktables and a wall of bead art at Pindo Puppy
这是一个家庭工作坊，我们把家里的一个房间，慢慢变成了拼豆小屋。

你可以来体验拼豆，也可以购置自己的拼豆工具；你可以买下拼豆作品，也可以定制独一无二的图案。
Come for a bead-making experience, pick up tools for home, choose a handmade piece, or talk to us about a pattern made just for you.
